REAL NASA 3D MOON MODEL:
Download moon_small.glb from https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/14959/
Then rename and put it right here:
  nasa-moon-color.glb
You may also copy it from an older LUNARIS project where NASA model status showed LOADED.
This model file is not packaged because NASA's binary could not be downloaded during creation.
Run npm.cmd run dev to attempt the official download automatically.
